title: P3208 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P3208 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P3208 corn is a white hybrid corn variety. 102 to 109 days to harvest, 7 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: P3208 corn is a white hybrid corn variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1986. Pioneer Overseas bred it. It takes 102 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** 102 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P3208 corn takes 102 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 4.4 days longer than the average of the 25 white hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 101.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7 t/ha beats the average of its group, 6.21. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant P3208 corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 102 to 109 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P3208?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
